text:
viv: merged arbor/cust-lora-int4 into staging. used int4-attn + q4_0 for matmuls. kicking off arbor-quickpack now.
carlos: did the LoRA add any added_tokens or special markers?
anya: training used an inline marker <AMT_RAW> via added_tokens but we didn't change prod tokenizer file. could split.
viv: eval started on ded-cluster-3, ETA ~20m.
eval-bot: QuickEval complete: arbor-compat-pack@arbor-lora-int4
  summary: 72/88 checks passed, 16 flagged
  regressions: invoice amount extraction F1 -3.9% (baseline 90.8 -> 87.2)
  hotspots: special-token splitting (<AMT_RAW> -> ['<','AMT_RAW','>']), negative amounts, thousands-sep noise
  artifacts: s3://redwood/artifacts/arbor/6587654321/quickpack-report.html
carlos: can you paste a small repro?
anya: repro (sanitized):
  Input: "Total: <AMT_RAW>-$1,234.50"
  Expected: {"amount":"1234.50","currency":"USD"}
  Model: amount:"1 234 . 50", note:"token < AMT_RAW >"
viv: tokenizer split + int4 attention seems to increase probability mass on spacing/punctuation tokens.
carlos: plan: 1) short-term: runtime postproc remap collapse ['<','AMT_RAW','>'] -> '<AMT_RAW>' and normalize numeric whitespace, 2) mid-term: mixed-quant export keeping lm_head & out_proj fp16 and re-run quickpack, 3) long-term: add_special_tokens to tokenizer and do a light fusion train.
anya: adding an exact-match numeric canonicalization test to the quickpack so future runs gate faster.
eval-bot: note: customer arbor rollback threshold = 2.5% F1 drop for invoice pipeline (current 3.9% -> blocks deploy).
ops-bot: created ticket FIN-4077: "arbor LoRA int4 token-split / parse regression" assigned to viv. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/FIN-4077\viv: implementing runtime remap + mixed-quant export now. will run the quickpack again and attach artifacts. :eyes:
carlos: also run a perf probe comparing mixed-quant vs full q4_0 (p50/p95 token latency, tokens/sec) so we understand runtime cost of keeping head fp16.
anya: noted. will add perf probes to quickpack.
viv: thanks team. will report back with new numbers and next steps. :thumbsup:
